templates._placeholder_rule: {personal_line} is the personal sentence followed by a blank line, or removed entirely when there is none.
templates.first_message:
Hi {first_name},

{personal_line}I'm exploring new opportunities at {company}. I have professional experience in GIS implementation, Python/ArcPy automation, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, GeoServer infrastructure, and Keycloak/OIDC-secured services, including deploying a two-node GeoServer setup and implementing database backup and recovery.

Given my background, would you be open to referring me for a suitable opportunity at {company}? I have attached my CV for your consideration.

Best,
Ajay
templates.second_ask: Thanks, I'll review the openings and identify a role that aligns with my experience. If I find a suitable position, would you be willing to refer me for that specific role? I can share the job link and my CV to make it easier.
templates.connect_note: Hi {first_name}, I came across your profile and work in geospatial technology. I specialize in GIS, PostGIS database schemas, and Python data pipelines. Would welcome connecting with you. Best, Ajay
templates.follow_up: Hi {first_name}, a gentle follow-up on my earlier note. If there is a suitable opening at {company}, I would be grateful for a referral, and I am happy to send my CV. Thank you either way.
